_comment: Change-type -> required-artifact routing for THIS repo (a library of skills and gate scripts). check-change-routing.mjs fires a rule when the change's added/changed files match its 'when' globs, then requires each 'requires' artifact to be part of the SAME change (or a valid waiver). It checks PRESENCE only; 'ownerGate' names the gate that checks the artifact's CORRECTNESS. These two rules key on this repo's real change-types. For an app, copy assets/example/routing-rules.config.json, which adds schema/UI/auth/source rules, and tune the globs to your stack. '**' spans directories; '*' and '?' do not cross '/'.

rules.description: A new skill is a significant, lasting decision. Record why it exists in the same change (architectural-decision-records).

requires.hint: add an ADR under docs/adr/ recording why this skill exists and what it owns

rules.description: A new gate or script is only trustworthy with a discriminating test that proves it detects. Ship the test in the same change (verifiable-quality-gates). Covers every new scripts/*.mjs, not only check-*, so a verify-*/run-*/*-lint gate cannot ship untested; a genuinely untestable scaffold is waived with a reason.

requires.hint: add a test under test/ that spawns the new gate and asserts its exit codes on clean and dirty inputs

rules.description: A new gate script (check-*.mjs) must be registered in gate-manifest.json in the SAME change, so the manifest can never silently under-promise relative to the gates the skills ship (ADR-0109, #204). This catches the omission at change time; check-upstream-manifest-integrity verifies the registration is correct and complete at CI. Keyed on ADDED, not changed, so editing an existing upstream-only or helper script does not false-fire (those need no manifest change). A new self-governance gate that is deliberately bootstrap-v2-upstream-only is the one exception and is waived with a reason.

requires.hint: register the new gate in gate-manifest.json (gates or consumerRequiredGates); or, if it is a self-governance gate, mark it bootstrap-v2-upstream-only and add a routing waiver with a reason
